title: WhatsApp inbox
description: Every message sent to the company WhatsApp number — what the bot saved and what it replied.

summary.openEntriesHint: Open Add entry — the entry is listed under the latest entries

reject.tooltip: Mark as rejected and void the entry or expense it created
reject.title: Reject WhatsApp message
reject.messageLinked: Rejecting voids the entry or expense this message created (and any partner investment derived from it). The voided row stays in the books for the audit trail; totals no longer count it. The sender is not notified.
reject.messageNoLink: This message has no active entry or expense, so nothing will be voided — it is only marked as rejected. The sender is not notified.
reject.reasonHint: Saved in the audit log and shown on the message.
reject.successVoided: Message rejected — the linked record was voided

reparse.tooltip: Run this message through the parser again
reparse.title: Re-parse message
reparse.message: The message runs through the same pipeline as a new WhatsApp message. If it parses, a new entry or expense is saved and the bot sends its reply to the sender again.
reparse.allowListNote: The sender must still be on the allow-list (Settings → WhatsApp), otherwise the message is rejected again.
reparse.replied: Re-parsed — the bot replied, nothing was saved

simulate.title: Simulate a WhatsApp message
simulate.intro: Runs the exact same pipeline as a real message from Meta — entries are really saved. Use it to test the format before Meta is connected. The reply is shown here instead of being sent.
simulate.fromHint: Must be on the allow-list in Settings → WhatsApp, in international format.
simulate.textHint: First line is the entry; any further lines are saved as notes. Ctrl+Enter sends.
simulate.placeholder:
RENT | EE2-251001 | 45 | cash | Salman
Notes go on the next line
simulate.useExample: Put this example in the message box
simulate.noReply: The bot did not reply to this message.
simulate.notAllowed: This number is not on the allow-list. Add it in

help.title: Message format
help.intro: One line, fields separated by | (vertical bar). Keywords are not case-sensitive.

formats.rent: RENT | unit | amount | payment | received by
formats.repair: REPAIR | amount | labour 50 parts 30 | payment | received by
formats.part: PART | item name | amount | payment | received by
formats.sale: SALE | unit | amount | payment | received by
formats.exp: EXP | vendor | amount | paid by | category

help.payment: Payment: cash, bank, card, mobilepay, revolut, wise, paypal
help.people: Received by / paid by: Ahmed, Salman, Company Account, Cash
help.discount: Discount: add "DISC 5" after the amount. VAT / NOVAT overrides the VAT invoice flag.
help.notes: Write notes on the next line.
help.undo: UNDO cancels the sender's last entry (within 10 minutes).
help.sendHelp: Sending HELP to the number replies with this list.

empty.title: No WhatsApp messages yet
empty.hint: Messages appear here as soon as the partners write to the company number. You can try it now with a simulated message.
empty.filteredHint: Choose another status or date range, or clear the filters.

validation.phone: Use an international phone number like +358401234567
validation.textTooLong: The message is too long (max 4096 characters)
